notes.note: Rows 102-115 are a 14-row party variant block that Quest007.bla never references (Event002/003 play only Wing Zero's row 101 after the battle). 102 voiced as Heero (military 'returning'); 106/111 polite (desu ne) = OOO/Mebius slots; 108 rough exclamation = Momotaros slot (same +4/+6/+9 positions as the verified polite/rough rows in the 39-52 and 62-75 blocks). Identical Japanese kept identical.

OkWin system message (Quest007 TextIdOffset+115, the no-Wing-Zero branch). Mapping in this table: TextIdOffset+N plays row N+1 (verified: +2 row 3 ???/Altron, +3 row 4 Wing Zero, +58 row 59 narration, +79 row 80 Ankh).

Quest title from QuestMess 0.8 'Two Mobile Dolls'. Played via OkWinIn(TextIdOffset+116). The script's next OkWinIn(+117) points past the last row (118 entries, 0-117), and row 100 'Obtained Planate Defenser' (quest_006) is not referenced: the item-get message looks off by one in the original script. Not a translation issue.

Quest description row (no speaker). Quest 9 title in QuestMess is 'Crazygon Hunt'; place name follows QuestMess ('Desert Cube'), brackets dropped. Compressed to fit 2 lines ('go there and hear Maganac out' -> 'Go see Maganac').
Rows 5-9 and 18: Maganac (CHARA_NAME 79), polite, verified in Quest008.bla (Event001 +4..+8, Event002 +17). 'Quicksand Zone' brackets dropped for a place name (glossary term).
The source sets 'power' in brackets (the heroes' lost power); kept in quotes, matching story usage ('take back the "power"').
Not referenced by Quest008.bla (the no-00 path just shows the system OkWin). Speaker inferred: Maganac (polite, -san on 00 dropped). 00 g=m ('him' as in source 'kare').

Rows 23-37 are an unreferenced 15-row leader block in the same order as the played 43-57 block: the first five slots (Seven, Zero, Mebius, Taro, Ultraman) recognise Crazygon (an Ultraseven robot), the rest see it for the first time. Row 38 also unreferenced; speaker unknown, voiced neutral-casual.
Rows 40-41: Crazygon name box (CHARA_NAME 97, Event003 +39/+40); 41 is narration shown under that box, past tense like other quest narration. Row 42 unreferenced, speaker unknown.

Leader block 43-57 = TextIdOffset+42+pt. Pt_Chara_Check order (Event003): Seven, Zero, Mebius, Taro, Ultraman, OOO, W (Shotaro), Den-O Sword (Momotaros), Black RX, Rider 1, 00, Wing Zero, God Gundam, Zeta, Nu (default). Wording matches: 44 Zero/49 Shotaro rough 'konee', 50 Momotaros 'ponkotsu robo', 52 Rider 1, 53 Setsuna 'mokuhyou wo kuchiku suru' (story form 'eliminating the target'), 54 Heero, 57 Amuro. 'Kochira kara iku' read as the leader speaking for the team ('we').

Ankh (CHARA_NAME 36), Event003 +61. 'Scrap Iron' is the item name (ItemNameFormal 3.53) and is quoted in the source. Rows 64-78 (same leader order, TextIdOffset+63+pt) answer him: 64/67/68 Seven/Taro/Ultraman know Crazygon was an iron-collecting robot; 66 Mebius polite; 69 OOO; 70 Shotaro; 71 Momotaros; 76 God; 77 Zeta; 74/75/78 00/Wing Zero/Nu. 'They' = the enemy behind the Crazygons. Row 63 unreferenced, speaker unknown.
Rows 81 and 91 are unreferenced (the no-00 path shows the system OkWin +164). Speaker inferred as Ankh (rough 'baka yarou'); subject 'you' restored for the party.
Ankh, Event004 +87, after the battle. 'Iron Ore' is the item name (ItemNameFormal 3.98).

report: 80/80 rows examined. Speakers from Quest007/008.bla (TextIdOffset+N = row N+1 in both tables). Quest007 102-115 unreferenced party variants (voiced from wording); its final OkWin +117 points past the table and row 100 is never shown (script off-by-one, not a translation issue). Quest008: Maganac 5-9/18, Crazygon 40-41/84, Ankh 62/79/88, leader blocks 43-57 and 64-78 in Pt_Chara_Check order. Unreferenced: 16, 23-38, 42, 63, 81, 91 (speakers inferred). Item names Scrap Iron / Iron Ore from ItemNameFormal. No new names.
